name: ENKI Entity Resolution Vocabulary Pack
description: Canonical entity resolution rules + closed entity subtype vocabulary for the Enki knowledge graph. v0.6 drops the 7 stub enrichment types (property_records, satellite_imagery, registration_lookup, flight_history, port_calls, social_profiles, news_mentions); enrichment is now operator-triggered per-type from the dossier UI. v0.5 added entity_subtypes.json (the source of truth for valid canonical_type values) and fixed alias_seeds.json to use only valid subtypes. The LDU consults entity_subtypes at write time (admit_candidate) and the trigger enforces it at the DB layer.

metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.change_control: v0.6: dropped 7 stub enrichment types (property_records, satellite_imagery, registration_lookup, flight_history, port_calls, social_profiles, news_mentions). Switched enrichment model to operator-triggered per-type. v0.5: added entity_subtypes.json (closed vocabulary) + fixed alias_seeds.json (removed country/state/military_branch/military_facility — those are not valid entity subtypes). LDU lock-down patch coordinated.
